c23334088.notes: Target is the small hanging shop sign at top right (Mendefera main street); it occupies a small part of the frame and bunting partly covers its lower line. Vertical side panel reads VIDEO. The round traffic pictograms (no bicycles / no carts) are distractors with no text.
